# Pricing and plans

- Route: `/pricing`
- Kind: `page`
- Category: `pricing`

## Summary

The plans compared: no account, a free account, Premium and Pro. Every plan runs the same tools on the same hardware; what changes is the daily volume, file size, output resolution, saved projects, the GPU queue and ads. The numbers are live on the page (quote them only from the live plan block).

## Details

Every plan runs the same tools on the same hardware. What changes is how much you can put through them in a day.
- No account: Open a tool and go. Nothing to sign up for, nothing stored beyond the day.
- Free account: Six times the daily volume, saved history, and Darkroom projects that survive a refresh.
- Premium: 4K output, long files, priority on the GPU queue, and no ads.
- Pro: Everything in Premium, much higher daily limits for operations, AI jobs and exports, and the largest Motion allowance.
Rows compared on the page: Everyday jobs per day; AI jobs per day; Maximum file size; Maximum video length; Maximum output resolution; Saved Studio projects; GPU queue; Ads; Darkroom exports per day; Motion exports per day; Saved Motion projects; Saved Aperture projects; Largest Aperture export; Aperture photos per batch; Saved Aperture presets; {{medi}} site guide; {{medi}} copilot edits per day; Darkroom export formats; Darkroom animated captions.
### FAQ
Q: What counts toward my daily allowance?
A: Each plan has two separate daily allowances that add up. An everyday job is one conversion, compression, transcode or other standard tool. An AI job is one run of a tool that uses an AI model, such as transcription, upscaling or vocal removal. An AI job never uses up an everyday job, so you can use every AI job and still have every everyday job. Darkroom exports have their own allowance. Previews, probes and downloads are free — you are only charged for work the server actually does.
Q: What happens when I run out?
A: Nothing breaks. The tool tells you the allowance is spent and offers the next tier up. Your allowance resets at midnight UTC.
Q: Do free accounts see ads?
A: Yes. Ads pay for the free tier, so only Premium and Pro remove them. There are never more than two ads on a page, never over the tools, and never on the home, pricing, account or legal pages. There are no interstitials, countdowns or forced waits on any plan.
Q: Can I use it without an account at all?
A: Yes, and that is deliberate. Every tool works signed out — an account just raises the ceiling and keeps your history. Without an account your files are kept for 24 hours; with an account you choose how long, from 24 hours to 2 years.
Q: What does Aperture cost?
A: Editing in Aperture is free: previews, every adjustment, masks, looks and undo cost nothing. Each export counts as one everyday job, selecting a subject with AI counts as one everyday job (repeating the same request is free), and each time you press Heal counts as one AI job. What changes with your plan is how many projects you can save, how large an export can be and how many photos you can edit in one batch; the table above lists the numbers.
Premium and Pro are monthly or yearly subscriptions paid with Stripe and can be cancelled any time from Account → Billing.
